description: UK: Statutory Maternity Pay (2026/27): 90% of average weekly pay for 6 weeks, then £194.32 or 90% if lower for 33 weeks; average pay must be at least £129 a week. Optional employer scheme (full-pay weeks, then half pay plus SMP), and the gap against normal pay before tax.

eligible.description: 26 weeks with the employer by the qualifying week (default true)

employerFullWeeks.description: Weeks the employer pays full pay (SMP counts towards it)

employerHalfWeeks.description: Weeks after that at half pay plus SMP

weeklyPay.description: Average weekly earnings before tax, GBP

name: uk_statutory_maternity_pay
title: uk statutory maternity pay
